reason: An observability exporter that converts DeepSeek Harness session events into sanitized OpenTelemetry and Langfuse traces and metrics with batching, retries, and bounded offline buffering.

summaries.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 会话事件转换为经清理的 OpenTelemetry 和 Langfuse 追踪与指标并导出到配置的后端。
summaries.en: Exports sanitized DeepSeek Harness session events as OpenTelemetry and Langfuse traces and metrics to configured backends.

capabilities: Collects spans and token, cost, and context metrics
Sanitizes and truncates prompt, completion, and tool data
Transmits telemetry to configured OTLP or Langfuse endpoints
Writes sanitized records to a bounded durable offline buffer
Provides an optional runtime export enable/disable remote
